title: stopChaosEngine swaps probe wait delay and timeout; timeout skips engine stop
expected: Wait up to Timeout seconds polling every Delay seconds; then patch ChaosEngine engineState=stop when stopOnFailure is true.
actual: Arguments reversed; short wait. On FailureTypeProbeTimeout returns without stopping engine.
root_cause: Inverted arguments to checkForErrorInContinuousProbe in stopChaosEngine.
user_impact: Continuous/onChaos probes with stopOnFailure may not abort experiments.

title: OnChaos probe duration collapses when initialDelay is set (k8s/prom/source cmd)
expected: OnChaos runs for chaos duration minus initialDelay in seconds.
actual: Subtracts int(time.Duration) nanoseconds; duration becomes 0 after typical delays.
root_cause: Inconsistent with inline OnChaos cmd which uses InitialDelay.Seconds().
user_impact: OnChaos probes effectively no-op after initial delay.

title: Package-level err variable shared across probe goroutines
expected: Per-probe error isolation for verdict aggregation.
actual: var err error mutated from multiple goroutines.
evidence: static analysis; go test -race recommended upstream
user_impact: Wrong probe verdict with multiple continuous probes.

title: Runner GetChaosEngine retry waits 2 nanoseconds not 2 seconds
expected: 2s backoff between Get retries (as in runner_test.go).
actual: Wait(time.Duration(2)) without time.Second.
user_impact: Runner fails fast on transient API errors.

title: InitialPatchEngine appends experiment status on runner restart
expected: Idempotent reconcile: one status row per experiment.
actual: Appends duplicate Waiting rows; first match wins on patch.
root_cause: Append without dedup; runner pod OnFailure restart.
user_impact: Stale Waiting status rows; confusing engine status.

title: Failed chaos-runner container never completes ChaosEngine
expected: Terminal runner failure should stop or error the engine.
actual: Only Terminated.Reason==Completed counts; PodFailed leaves engine initialized.
user_impact: Engines stuck active/initialized after runner crash.

title: Abort updates only first ChaosResult for engine UID
expected: All ChaosResults for chaosUID updated on abort.
actual: Return after first matching result in namespace list.
user_impact: Multi-experiment engines leave stale results.

title: Workflow run phase Completed despite fault fail; probe-failure status unused
expected: Failed faults yield Completed_With_Probe_Failure or Error in run phase.
actual: Argo Failed and Succeeded map to Completed; node phase from ChaosResult Phase; verdict ignored.
root_cause: Phase mapping and dead branch for Completed_With_Probe_Failure.
user_impact: Dashboard shows success while faults_failed>0.

title: Stop run marks Mongo completed then rejects subscriber updates
expected: Stop shows Stopped with final execution_data matching cluster.
actual: completed=true on stop; UpdateExperimentRun requires completed=false.
root_cause: Disconnect guard without terminal event merge path.
user_impact: Stale execution graph after stop.

title: Stop/delete ChaosEngines scanned in infra namespace only
expected: Stop targets engines in resolved adminModeNamespace.
actual: StopChaosEngineState(INFRA_NAMESPACE) only.
root_cause: Namespace parameter not aligned with resolveEngineNamespace.
user_impact: Chaos keeps running after API stop in admin mode.

title: ExecutionData base64 fallback uses ExperimentID
expected: Fallback to raw executionData JSON string.
actual: exeData = []byte(event.ExperimentID).
user_impact: Broken execution graph for legacy subscribers.

title: GraphQL ExperimentRunStatus enum missing Completed_With_Probe_Failure
expected: TS and GraphQL enums align.
actual: Frontend defines value absent from GraphQL enum.
user_impact: Filters/codegen cannot represent probe-failure phase.

title: GetExperimentRunStats includes removed runs
expected: Same is_removed filter as ListExperimentRun.
actual: Match project_id only.
user_impact: Inflated dashboard counts.

title: Cmd/HTTP probe mode case-sensitive vs RunProbes lowercase
expected: Mode matching consistent across probe types.
actual: Cmd/http use case-sensitive switches; Edge verdict guard exact case.
user_impact: Lowercase modes silently skip probes.

title: Resiliency weight matched by substring on engine name
expected: Deterministic fault-to-weight mapping.
actual: strings.Contains in map iteration order.
user_impact: Wrong resiliency score when fault names overlap.

title: Cron timezone not stored in API cron_syntax
expected: API exposes schedule + timezone for display/next-run reasoning.
actual: Only Spec.Schedule copied to CronSyntax.
user_impact: UI/cluster schedule mismatch across timezones.

title: ListExperimentRun panics or errors on empty aggregation result
expected: Empty list returns total=0, runs=[], err=nil.
actual: err!=nil || len==0 branch calls err.Error() when err is nil → panic.
user_impact: GraphQL crash listing runs for empty filters.

title: RunSequence reset on every subscriber event update
expected: RunSequence immutable after run creation.
actual: Set to TotalExperimentRuns+1 on each UpdateExperimentRun.
root_cause: Recomputed from counter on every event.
user_impact: Run history sequence jumps during live run.

title: Invalid updatedBy in run event Fatalf kills GraphQL server
expected: Return error to subscriber; do not exit process.
actual: logrus.Fatalf on base64 decode failure.
user_impact: Single bad event takes down ChaosCenter API.

title: Run event parses probes from latest revision not event.RevisionID
expected: Probes match manifest used for the run.
actual: Uses experiment.Revision[len-1].
user_impact: Run probe list wrong after manifest edits.

title: getChaosStatus panics on malformed annotation keys
expected: Skip or safely parse annotation keys without `/`.
actual: strings.Split(k,"/")[1] on short keys panics.
user_impact: Operator crash on abort with unexpected annotations.
